title: Every Tour de France, mapped: from a lap of France to a race that hops
excerpt: I mapped all 2,427 stages of the Tour de France since 1903, start to finish. For thirty years it was one unbroken loop round the edge of France; now 88% of stages start somewhere new, the race is 42% shorter than in 1926 and faster than ever.
seo_description: Every Tour de France stage since 1903 on one map: the giant loop, 27 Grand Départs abroad, Paris, Bordeaux and Pau, and a shorter, faster race.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Every Tour de France, mapped' in black and red, with 'Tour de' on a yellow band, beside a map of France covered in thin coloured lines for every stage since 1903, with the 1926 route drawn in thick yellow as a loop round the edge of the country. Text: 2,427 stages, 1903 to 2026, start to finish; the 1926 loop in yellow, 5,745 km, the longest Tour.
